prompt: Nadia switches to a new study method. Her first quiz score drops slightly, so she wants to abandon it immediately. What is the most evidence-based response?

options.text: Check the trend over several quizzes and whether that quiz covered different material, before judging the method from one result
Abandon it, because a good method should improve the very first score
Keep it forever, because new methods always work eventually
Judge it by how enjoyable the first session felt

explanation: One score is a tiny, noisy sample affected by topic and difficulty. A fair test pre-decides a trial period and compares a trend, not a single data point.
